mapper.select: SELECT ptc.user_id, u.wechat_nickname, pt.task_reward, ptc.completion_status, ptc.completion_time FROM publisher_task_completion ptc LEFT JOIN publisher_task pt ON ptc.task_id = pt.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ptc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ptc.task_id = #{taskId} AND ptc.deleted = false AND pt.task_type_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 6) ORDER BY ptc.completion_time DESC

SELECT ptc.user_id as inviter_user_id, u.wechat_nickname as wechat_work_nickname, JSON_EXTRACT(ptc.completion_detail, '$.invitedUser.userId') as invited_user_id, JSON_EXTRACT(ptc.completion_detail, '$.invitedUser.wechatId') as invited_wechat_id, JSON_EXTRACT(ptc.completion_detail, '$.invitedUser.wechatNickname') as invited_wechat_nickname, pt.task_reward, ptc.completion_status, JSON_EXTRACT(ptc.completion_detail, '$.inviteStartTime') as invite_start_time, ptc.completion_time as invite_success_time FROM publisher_task_completion ptc LEFT JOIN publisher_task pt ON ptc.task_id = pt.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ptc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ptc.task_id = #{taskId} AND ptc.deleted = false AND pt.task_type_id = 5 ORDER BY ptc.completion_time DESC

SELECT t.rank_id, t.user_id, t.wechat_nickname, t.earned_reward FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.earned_reward DESC) AS rank_id, s.user_id, s.wechat_nickname, s.earned_reward FROM ( SELECT ptc.user_id, u.wechat_nickname, SUM(ptc.reward_amount) AS earned_reward FROM publisher_task_completion ptc LEFT JOIN publisher_task pt ON ptc.task_id = pt.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ptc.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ptc.task_id = #{taskId} AND ptc.deleted = false AND ptc.completion_status = 2 AND pt.task_type_id = 7 AND ptc.completion_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ptc.user_id, u.wechat_nickname ORDER BY earned_reward DESC LIMIT #{topCount} ) s ) t ORDER BY t.earned_reward DESC
